decisions: Fonts that cannot be decoded fail closed: their text is withheld as U+FFFD with a recorded reason (textWithheld, stored in evidence_documents.text_withheld), never guessed; a font that cannot be resolved at all is withheld too. A page with only withheld text has no text, so a document with nothing decodable is PDF_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE.

A malformed CMap is refused as a whole (the font's text is withheld) rather than partially trusted; a CMap or font count over a bound rejects the document (CMAP_TOO_LARGE, TOO_MANY_FONTS), consistent with NFR-04: a bound is a typed rejection, never silent truncation.

Symbol-font private-use code points (U+F020-U+F0FF) are read through the Adobe Symbol encoding for fonts whose BaseFont is Symbol; U+F020 is a space for any font; other private-use code points are withheld.

Re-derivation semantics follow M05 (spans and documents immutable, replacement is an append-only event): migration 0024 keys a document by parser version; a re-ingest whose extraction changed records a new derived document that supersedes and withdraws the old one (reason REDERIVED_BY_PARSER) and so a new evidence revision; an unchanged extraction is reused; a withdrawn derivation is not resurrected; reopenCitation re-derives with the recorded parser version, and the v1/v2 decoder is kept verbatim (byte-identical span digests for the manual are pinned in T-021).

Migration 0024 replaces a unique constraint in one step. The migrations README asks for rolling-safe changes; no database outside throwaway test and journey databases exists (T-057 deployment is NOT_RUN), so no running reader of the old shape exists. Recorded in the migration header.

The layout rule (each Tm/BT fragment starts a new line, so Word-split words such as 'Tempera' / 'ture' stay split) is unchanged: it is not an encoding defect and changing it would need glyph widths; recorded as a finding.

Accepted after review: composite-font codespace lookup is linear in the 2M-character text budget (79 ms per 200k glyphs at the 256-range worst case).
Remaining extraction limits: text in Form XObjects (diagram labels) is not extracted; words split by the producer into separately positioned fragments stay split across lines.
The validator checks that a quote appears in the cited span, not that it supports the extracted value (the MANUFACTURER field quotes 'XR60CX'). The validator was intentionally not changed.
